name: Varrik the Just
description: A man formerly Varrik the Bloody, transformed after an angel rose above him.

description_citations.text: Magic 2013: card flavor text (Magic 2013, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: An angel rose above Varrik the Bloody, who died as Varrik the Just was born.
timeline.quote: She rose above me, and in that moment Varrik the Bloody died and I was born.

citation.text: Angel's Mercy (Magic 2013, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
